messages:
alex: Hey all, new hire here. I completed SSO and connected the company VPN but can't reach internal registry at registry.corp.redwood:5000. Client shows connected. Anyone seen this on Day 1?

it-bot: Welcome @alex! Tagging @devon (IT) and @netops for network assist. Check onboarding guide: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/vpn-access if you can view it.

devon: Welcome! Quick q's: are you on a company laptop or BYOD? Which OS and VPN client version?

alex: BYOD MacBook Pro, macOS 14.3, VPN client NetSecure 3.1.0 (installed from SSO portal).

lee: Most likely split-tunnel not pushing internal routes. Run `scutil --dns` and `netstat -rn | grep 10.` to see if corporate DNS and routes are present.

alex: `netstat -rn | grep 10.` returns nothing. `scutil --dns` shows system DNS only (my home resolver).

devon: That confirms it. Temporarily toggle "Route all traffic" in NetSecure prefs to see if registry becomes reachable (tradeoff: slower web). If that fixes it, we'll push the 10.11/10.12 prefixes to your profile.

alex: Toggled route-all, restarted client, same result. `ping 10.11.8.4` times out.

netops: If ping/route fail while connected it might be a tun interface MTU/fragmentation issue or firewall rules blocking your IP. Can you `curl -v https://registry.corp.redwood:5000/v2/` ? Also `ifconfig utun0` to see mtu.

alex: `ifconfig utun0` shows mtu 1500. `curl -v` hangs during TLS handshake.

lee: TLS hang + MTU 1500 could mean path MTU causing TLS record fragmentation. Try reducing tunnel MTU: `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400` and retry curl.

alex: Lowered MTU -> `curl -v` now returns 403 (access denied) but it's the registry responding. Good sign.

devon: 403 is expected because your onboarding IAM role isn't yet permitted to pull that repo. I'll add you to `dev-registry-read` group. Give me your Okta username.

alex: username a.kim@redwood.

devon: Done. Try docker pull. Also netops please note NetSecure 3.1 clients sometimes ignore pushed DNS; need explicit DNS in profile. Ticket ONB-4710 opened.

netops: Noted. I've updated the onboarding profile to push 10.11.0.0/16 and DNS 10.11.0.10 for NetSecure 3.1 family. Also added a temporary firewall allowance from alex's public IP so cert provisioning can complete.

alex: docker pull now works, thanks. One oddity: the registry cert CN is registry.internal and the host is registry.corp.redwood so curl earlier failed when MTU was high (weird).

lee: That mismatch could show up when a public DNS leaks or cert SANs differ. Glad reduced MTU exposed the server correctly. We'll sync PKI to include corp.redwood SANs for registry to avoid this.

devon: Quick onboarding note: BYOD is allowed but we recommend company-managed devices to reduce steps (device profile export, client profile id, cert provisioning). We'll update the onboarding checklist to capture client version, `ifconfig utun0` output, and your public IP for faster support.

alex: Great — appreciate the help and speedy fixes!

it-bot: Ticket ONB-4710 created for NetSecure profile update and ONB-4711 for registry SAN update.

alex: Marking resolved on my side. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
